title: The Great Scale Rebalancing
skyStory: A sliver of moon steps into Libra and immediately asks everyone to please be fair about the armrest. Venus has set up a tiny brass scale on the windowsill of the sky. On one side: the last warm afternoon. On the other: a pumpkin-coloured sweater. The scale wobbles all day. Saturn rolls its eyes and wears both.

reading: Libra is staring at your calendar with a pained expression. You have scheduled yourself like a man who believes days contain forty hours. Move one thing. Just one. Mars will grumble, but Mars also needs a nap and will thank you later.

At lunch, someone will offer to help with a task you were going to grind through alone. This is the [[Six of Pentacles]] tapping on the glass. Say yes before your mouth finishes saying no thanks. The Tiger does not lose stripes by letting someone else carry a box. In fact, receiving is a whole muscle you have been skipping, and Libra has signed you up for the class.
joel.mission: When someone offers help today, accept it with only the words thank you, no explaining, no counteroffer.
joel.omen: Two identical mugs side by side. Balance is coming back to a week that felt lopsided.

reading: A Libra moon makes you the unofficial referee of every small dispute within a fifty metre radius. Who gets the window seat. Whose turn it is to refill the printer. You will settle at least one of these with a single raised eyebrow, and history will remember your fairness.

Evening is for you, though. The shore is calling with that early September light that goes gold at 6:50 pm and makes everything look like a postcard someone kept. Go stand near water if you can, or near a window if you cannot. Your Life Path 11 hears things in quiet that other people need a megaphone for. Listen for one small idea and keep it.
nancy.mission: Settle one tiny household debate with a coin toss, and accept the coin's verdict with dramatic dignity.
nancy.omen: Two mismatched socks on a clothesline, flapping in perfect sync. Two halves of your lopsided week are finally working together.

together.text: Each of you name one thing you have been doing too much of and one thing too little. Swap lists and assign each other a tiny fix. Libra is officiating. Libra is very serious about this and has a whistle.

game.intro: The moon is in Libra, weighing everybody's choices. Tonight Saturn only weighs the wrong ones. Take your time.
game.question: How many sides does a stop sign have?
